notes.title: Monthly update August 2024.
notes.content:
Short update.

GalaxIverse II launch went well, no bug reports and good reviews.

Warlocks 4 toolchain is still under development, I am currently battling with importing model and animation data  ( using assimp library ).
Unlike previous warlocks games that loaded all the assets at the start of the game, Warlocks 4 will use a caching and discard method to only have assets that are currently needed,  This allows me to have much more content at higher resolutions and also speeds up the initial loading.

notes.title: Monthly update.
notes.content:
I plan to provide general monthly updates based around all my different games and how they are to be developed.  

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/suborbitalsoftware][b][u]Keep Up to date with new games and updates by joining my community group.[/u][/b][/url]

Galaxiverse II is launching 1st August and is free to play,  add to your Wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2750980/GalaxIverse_II/

Warlocks 4 ( unnamed ) is in planning stage and I am currently building the toolchain that I plan to use.

[u]Core objectives[/u]

AI to switch from a path generation system to a flow field system.  I think this will be much more fluid and less processor intensive.

Dynamic model loading, At present I load all models when the game loads, I will switch this to only load on demand.  This allows me to have far more items with higher resolution whilst speeding up loading and reducing the memory footprint.  This primarily applies to Hud/holding based items.

At present the engine supports 9 worlds of 16384x16384 voxels.  I'm going to half the map size but support far more worlds, Maybe even Fairspace size. ( I would like to mash Fairspace/warlocks together ).

Dedicated server to support 32 or maybe 64 players.

Tricks and traps in the constructions / Points of interest.

The game will be released as early access and will probably stay like that for a few years.

notes.title: Small Update 18th Jan 2023
notes.content:
Small tweaks to the Job system AI.

Originally the AI was scaled for party based combat and limits of AI per player were set to help spread the combat around.  This is no longer required and now actually gets in the way of finishing missions effectively.

notes.title: Update 16 Jan 2023
notes.content:
Lots of updates here. Probably going to let this bed in for a bit before the next release.

Remove version numbering information from the main game screen, Still available on title screen.  This is no longer needed since the migration from a MMO.

Removed the Crash prevention system, I believe this again doesn't fit with the single player aspect of the game and was originally designed to save you from server faults.  However not that there isn't a fixed server its mechanisms for recovering lost ships is actually corrupting good data.

Removed the network throttle system,  Again a holdover from the MMO days to help fix any client side lagging which I think may cause problems in the now zero latency system.

Fixed various text issues for item descriptions and skills.

Technology units / Missiles and torps are now shown on the database, However as there isn't a single point of comparison I just show the raw variables / commands that the item has.

XP has been reduced by 33%.

The Hide Hud option Keypad 0 now hides allot more of the Hud rather than just the left and right panels.

Highlight items text,  You can now select if you want the text to be in the box, to the right of the box or blank.  This data is normally duplicated in the bottom right panel.

notes.title: 11 Jan 2023 Small Update

Changed the way torps and missiles work, now once your primary missiles have run out it will try and find ant other missiles or tops that will work.

Warlock[ADS]

notes.title: Fairspace Update June 2018
notes.content:
As stated in February Fairspace will pivot away from the MMO server.   With this update user accounts are being relocated to steam cloud storage.  
This removes the need for a login process every time you want to play.

For existing players who wish to retrieve their previous characters rather than stating from fresh can simply click the Import button and enter the credentials,  This will download the character into the steam cloud.  With such a large update there may be unforeseen issues introduced,  So please post in the forums if you have any issues.

The account server will continue to function up to Christmas 2018.  This gives players 6 months to retrieve their characters.

notes.title: Fairspace Update Nov 2016
notes.content:
I have noticed players getting stuck on planet London, with not having a good enough heat shield to get away and out of the influence of the suns corona, So I have added a tow service that will take you to the nearest planet outside of the danger zone.  It is going to cost you 10% of your credits though.

General network connection diagnostics have been improved,  Please report any spurious network messages you may receive, the error codes are particularly important and will help me isolate any problems you may be having.

The previous update for shooting net code has been refined, I would really like to know of any issues either playing locally or on the MMO server.

notes.title: Fairspace Update July 2016
notes.content:
Panning left and right in your ship has been added, to that end movement controls have been overhauled,  If you have played before and have an existing keyboard configuration, I Recommend clicking the Controls Reset button on the configuration menu ( normally F9).
WSAD have been allocated to the basic movement of forwards and backwards left and right and the cam keys have been moved to the Numeric keypad.
As part of the keyboard update the 'F' key for free look has been changed into a toggle and alternates between free look and the default 3rd person view.
Q key is now the default for nearest enemy target.  This is positioned nicely next to movement controls.

Sound effects have been revisited, Explosions, hyper jumping and interface have been updated.

Ship Thrusters have been changed again, Is it an improvement ?

A bug on reading user environment variables has been fixed, this would cause the game to crash on its very first run but then work from then on.

Star field effect has been updated to give a better feel of movement at slower speeds.

Interface/Hud has been switched from flat to 3D,  For those that do not like this and would prefer to leave it flat there is slider control on the configuration screen to change it back.

Shooting Netcode has been updated, I realised the bullets were slightly off and appeared to be a frame or so behind the action, This has been corrected and now looks more solid.

notes.content:
This update concentrates mostly of graphic updates in an attempt to improve the look and feel of Fairspace prior to leaving early access.

Rewrote the shader for the star field and at warp effect.
Rewrote and redesigned the method for earth type planets including the shader and textures.

notes.title: Fairspace Update 22nd June 2015
notes.content:
[h1]Game Rebalance[/h1]

Allocations of equipment and ships to the different races have been refined, Fewer ships are now available at fewer locations.  The Database option helps players location where these ships can be purchased.
The difference between Lvl1 and Lvl99 used to be a factor of 36, This is now more like 3.6. the net effect is:-
[list]
[*]Combat with higher levels is now easier, a group of level 1's can defeat a level 10. 
[*]Cargo sizes have been greatly reduced in size.
[*]Missile targeting and damage has been updated. 
[*]Torps should now be necessary for destroying caps and stations.
[*]AI to AI fights no longer spawn loot
[/list]


[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]All prices and some ship properties have been amended.
[*]Some Space station graphics have been removed, Only the good ones are left, Space stations are now reallocated based on race.
[*]AI system has been redone to try and stop them crashing into planets.
[*]More of the adventure system released with special equipment being available via a kind of crafting system, Supply characters with several pieces of equipment and they will give you advanced weapons that are not available to be purchased at any planet. These characters need to be discoverd arround the univers.
[*]Some questes now allow direct map targeting without having to remember the locations name and search for it.
[*]Some repair charge bugs fixed.
[*]Job rewards increased.
[*]Another small change to the soundfx for weapons.
[*]Change to the specular lighting calcs.
[/list]

[i]Some players may get an error that some cargo has been lost if they left a ship in dock with a full cargo during this update,  This is due to the reduction is cargo sizes across all ships, This will only happen this once. I don't imagine any more significant balance changes going forwards.[/i]

notes.title: Fairspace Update 19th May 2015
notes.content:
Hi,

Lots of small fixes in the update, Plus one major update.
The Database system has been overhauled, You can now see where you can buy the equipment,ships and commodites that you are looking at, Locations are sorted nearest first and an additional button jumping you straight to that location on the map, allowing you to set your target.
The database also now supports showing the raw numbers as well as the pictorial graphs.

The ships for sale at each planet have been reorganised, with fewer ships at each location.
Some locations have had there names changed.
Bug on charging for repairs when using wormholes has been fixed.

notes.title: Fairspace Patch 14 May 2015
notes.content:
Bug fix on equipment screen rendering the left panel.

Parser system first launch, only certain tasks included:-

Go to jail for trading contrabands in any of the main systems, You will receive an initial warning before being Jailed.
Fixing your reputation with allies of planets your docket with.
Ship repairs now cost money, Unless you are well liked by the owners of the planet.
Certain planets and races will help you to upgrade your ships equipment up to and over your current level, for a fee.
Some people will offer to help you map the universe, You need to find them first and then follow there instructions.

These are repeatable adventure events, the more detailed story based events will be launched at a later date.

Quest have been removed from the game, being superseded by the adventure parser system.

All interface screens have been reengineered to appear centrally on all different sized screens, previously they were left oriented.

A few bits of icon snaz have been added.

Achievements removed and replaced for killing live players, These are now linked to parser events.

nebular cloud effect has been fixed, it had disappeared on a previous update.

Warn if trying to undock with a shield attached to your ship.

notes.title: Fairspace Update 4th May
notes.content:
Hi,
This is an unscheduled update, I broke something in the network code during the last update and have been forced to go early with this update.  Apologies to anyone who has had trouble staying connected to the server for the past few days.

This update Allows the game to be played on your own local server alone, Just you and the AI. Your character is interchangeable between Local and the MMO,  You can build a character and set of ships off line and then join the MMO server when you feel you are ready.

This is the Second last update before the planned exit from Early Access, Once I have launched the adventure layer and am happy with the performance of the servers I will exit Early Access. 

Thanks.

notes.title: Fairspace Update 16 Feb 2015
notes.content:
Projectile impacts improved to be a better looking effect rather than just a simple flat billboard.
Sound FX Modifications, Another round and another attempt, Not sure if its any better.
A rewrite of the explosion system and smoke trails, This has in my opinion greatly improved the explosions and impact effects of combat, Destroying enemy fighters is now far more satisfying to do.  Space station are much more impressive when destroyed.
Laser weapons fire points and destination now have particle effects to improve the look.
Small tweak to improve the new bloom system, A little more natural.

Secular maps added to models, Secular was generally broken, it isn't anymore.
Planet surfaces removed the excessive secular that made them look glossy, I had been told about this some time ago but never reached it on my list of things to do.

Missiles and torps amended to the new trail and projectile methods.  I am concerned about the Damage for missiles and have it under review.

There is a chance that some of the changes to the pixel shaders may not compile for all graphics cards, Posting your qbootlog.txt file will allow me to quickly resolve the issue, The last 20 lines or so will do.

Environment map amended / enhanced, stage 1, This adds to the model effects, I haven't yet decided to do dynamic environment maps, I don't know if its worth the effort.

After you have visited the teleport screen on a planet all the ship location will appear on your map, I will improve this and allow teleporting from the map screen on a later update.

The next round of updates will concentrate on content and adventure, as well as some specific requests.

notes.title: Fairspace Update 27 Jan 2015
notes.content:
Hi,

The folowing updates have been launched in this version 152 A. Please note that this is a mandatory update as the network protocol and ports have been changed.

Bug fix on map viewing - this caused a critical crash in certain circumstances.
Crash protection on character, If a crash occurs your character data will be retained, The feature can be turned off in the configuration screen.
Graphs graphic slight change.
Slight network protocol change to fix possible issue talking to worldserver.
Ping Test Implemented in the console / Whilst not connected to any server you can pop up the console and type 'PINGTEST' this will transmit 100 packets to both the account and worldserver testing the quality and speed of your network connection, A summary is presented after the test is complete.
Rewrite of the bloom shader / Reducing graphics memory while improving quality.
Change to the games port settings, Requiring a forced protocol update.
Initial ship changed, Due to feedback I have changed the first ship you get when creating a new character.

Thank you to all those who help push Fairspace forwards and apologies to those players hit by bugs.

notes.title: Critical Update 30 Dec 2014
notes.content:
A single fix patch,  New players had a 50/50 change of crashing when leaving there first docked location.  This was an obscure bug completely unrelated between cause and effect.
Apologies to all those players who were hit with this, The majority of which im sure didn't report it.

notes.title: Small Joystick Update. 22 dec 2014
notes.content:
An additioal option in the settings screen allows for a Joystick Look Spring.
Whilst in flight mode, enabling look spring will let your joystick control the position of the firing point in a analogue way so that each movement extent is in relation to the screen. The alternative is for joystick movement to directionally move the cursor.  This mode is only advisable for real joysticks rather than gamepads.
Enabling look spring will stop your mouse movement from functioning whilst in flight mode.

notes.title: Mini Patch - 30 Nov 2014
notes.content:
Hi, This is a small patch to address some issues highlighted recently. 

Bug fix for when first person view front and die by crashing into meteorites. Very obscure bug in the camera code. 

Bug Fix in Debret field, Some rocks didn't exist to the collision detection engine. 

Bug fix when killed by a Debret field, Narrative now names the nebular rather than just blaming the AI.. 

Amendment to FBO creation and Post processing. 

Loot boxes graphical change. Loot boxes were previously rendered over bright and were difficult to see the details on them.

notes.title: Fairspace patch 151-L.H.C. 23 Nov 2014
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

Update 151 - L.H.C., This is not an optional update, you will not be allowed to connect to the server if you haven't  applied this update.  This update covers mostly weapon graphics which I see as a major improvement in the look 
and feel of combat. 

As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the forum either here or through 
space sim central http://spacesimcentral.com/ssc/forum/78-fairspace/e


Changelog:
Missile/Torp scale and rendering.
Missile/Torp tail colour interpolation.
Small soundfx modifications.
Projectiles, complete redo of all rendering and effects surrounding projectile weapons.
Tweaks to the billboard shader system.

Cargo holds have been amended Both the base sizes and the tech units for increasing them.
This can have a slight side effect of loosing you cargo if you are sitting in space with a full cargo hold during the updatel
You will however receive a message saying you have lost cargo.

Space station lazer counts and tech units reduces. This only applies to newly purchased ships, Anything you allready own and have in storage
will continue as is.

If you take the skill points to reduce the cost of ships and equipment this will no longer reduce the second hand resale value of the items.

notes.title: Fairspace Update - 16 Nov 2014
notes.content:
Ambient sound effects have been added across the universe to improve the immersion into the game.
Hyperspace animation to better illustrate the distance and speed of travel taking place.
Global sound Fx boost, Sound Fx throughout the game have been updated.
Skyboxes have taken a step forwards in quality.
General hud amendments for text transitions.
Missiles and Torps rendering reworked for a better effect.
Missiles and Torps sound Fx fixes for both launch and explosion.
Removed all openmp code to try and fix some dual core timing issues.
General performance increases improved loading speed.

notes.title: Fairspace Update 09 Nov.
notes.content:
A mini update, a list of these updates is shown below:-

Release of the mall. A Service area where you can but extra ship slots, fix your rep or overpower your ship.
Release of extra equipment that can be used as part of the future crafting system. 
Rewrite of the model explosion routines, particularly for space stations and capital ships. 
Changed the graphics for ships on fire / damaged.
Bug fix on race achievements.
Explosion throw back removed.
Radiation areas to reduce hyperspace travel in certain map areas.
Small text transition changes.
